closed_scope: 175 remaining exact block/effect/setup methods;already pinned block registry initializer reused. Two registered native constructors add four distinct speed/jump property consumers to the existing shared motion profile;no duplicate mechanic. Native effect tick delegates reuse locked particles/status readers;environmental fire and container lifecycle remain explicit native contexts.

record_refinements.reason: The last two registered block constructors supply independently authored speed and jump properties; extend the existing native motion profile instead of duplicating it.
record_refinements.behavior_append: Exact registered SilkenSoil and SilkenStone constructors each declare speedFactor0.8999999761581421F and jumpFactor0.8999999761581421F. Four distinct property-consumer identities are retained, not one generic factor alias. Native Block/Entity/LivingEntity motion/contact and jump admission remain owned; no final realized velocity, guaranteed slowdown, player owner or attack source is invented. Other properties (strength/tool/light) are terrain setup. Existing crystal/flesh/web values are unchanged.
